rules.title: Document accountability and oversight
rules.requirement: Assign accountable owners for the AI system, its risk decisions, and escalation path. Preserve evidence of human oversight appropriate to the use context.

rules.title: Maintain an AI risk assessment and treatment record
rules.requirement: Maintain a documented risk assessment covering intended purpose, affected people, foreseeable misuse, likelihood, impact, treatment decisions, residual risk, and review date.

rules.title: Document data provenance and quality controls
rules.requirement: Document data sources, ownership, permitted use, quality limitations, representativeness, and controls for relevant data used by or supplied to the system.
rules.applicability: Systems using material datasets or retrieval sources

rules.title: Test performance, robustness, and foreseeable failures
rules.requirement: Define and retain evaluation methods, acceptance thresholds, representative test results, known limitations, and regression checks before consequential release and after material change.

rules.title: Constrain model output and downstream execution
rules.requirement: Treat model output as untrusted input. Validate and encode it before rendering, querying, or executing; require authorization and bounded permissions for tools and downstream actions.

frameworks.OWASP LLM Top 10 2026: LLM02: Sensitive Information Disclosure; LLM07: System Prompt Leakage

rules.title: Mitigate prompt injection and untrusted context
rules.requirement: Identify direct and indirect prompt-injection paths, treat retrieved and user-supplied content as untrusted, and test mitigations that prevent unauthorized disclosure or action.
rules.applicability: LLM systems processing user input or external context

rules.title: Minimize and protect sensitive information
rules.requirement: Identify personal and sensitive data flows, minimize collection and retention, apply access controls, and test for unintended disclosure through prompts, outputs, logs, and connected services.
rules.applicability: Systems handling personal or sensitive information

frameworks.EU AI Act: Article 10 (high-risk data governance); other privacy law may apply

rules.title: Communicate AI use and material limitations
rules.requirement: Inform relevant users when they interact with AI where appropriate or required, explain system capabilities and limitations, and provide instructions for contesting or escalating important outcomes.
rules.applicability: User-facing systems; requirements vary by use and jurisdiction

rules.title: Provide meaningful human review for consequential decisions
rules.requirement: For consequential or rights-affecting uses, define competent human review, authority to override or stop the system, escalation routes, and safeguards against automation bias.

rules.title: Monitor deployed system and manage incidents
rules.requirement: Monitor quality, safety, security, drift, and incidents in operation; assign response ownership; retain a route to suspend, roll back, or safely disable the system.

rules.title: Review third-party models and supply-chain dependencies
rules.requirement: Record material third-party models, datasets, tools, and services; assess security, provenance, contractual constraints, change notices, and fallback or exit options.
rules.applicability: Systems using third-party AI or material dependencies

rules.title: Assess EU AI Act role, scope, and risk classification
rules.requirement: Where EU AI Act territorial scope may apply, document provider/deployer/importer/distributor role, intended purpose, affected persons, risk classification, relevant obligations, and applicable dates; obtain qualified review for classification.
rules.applicability: EU market, users, or outputs potentially in scope
